{{Quote|I was&hellip; kept as a ''slave''&hellip; thought I would not see you again&hellip;''"<br />"''Where are the ''Republic monsters'' that did ''this'' to you?''"<br />"''Not ''Republic''&hellip; It was ''Count Dooku''!|Fodani and another [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]]|<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />}}
'''Fodani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was kept as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] in a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Unidentified Tatooine camp|camp]] until he was [[Mission to Tatooine (Yoda)|freed]] by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].
